title: Schneider / GE / OMRON / Mitsubishi / Triconex / Codesys ICS identification (no write/control)
description: Active identification of additional ICS vendors/protocols; read/identify only.
detail: Authorized, in-scope. Active + read/identify allowed; **NO WRITE/CONTROL/ACTUATION**. **Schneider Electric (Modicon):** Modbus/TCP 502 (+ UMAS function 0x5A for Modicon M340/M580/Quantum/Premium etc.) — enumerate device/PLC info read-only; no program/variable writes, no run/stop, no UMAS write operations. **Siemens:** S7comm 102 (S7-300/400/1200/1500) — s7-info/enumerate read-only; no CPU control/transfer/writes. **Rockwell/Allen-Bradley:** EtherNet/IP CIP 44818 — enip-info read-only; no CIP writes. **GE:** SRTP 18245 — identify read-only. **OMRON:** FINS 9600/udp(+tcp) — identify read-only. **Mitsubishi:** MELSEC 5007/5006 — identify read-only. **Triconex/Schneider SIS (network view):** Tristation 1502 — identify only; NEVER interact with safety/trip logic (read-only ID only, and treat as highly sensitive). **Codesys:** 2455 — identify read-only. **Wago/PCWorx:** 1962 — identify read-only. **Red Lion Crimson:** 789 — identify read-only. **Protocols also in scope:** DNP3 20000, IEC-60870-5-104 (2404), OPC UA 4840, BACnet 47808/udp, Modbus 502, PROFINET (discovery). Always verify NSE/scripts are identify/read-only; record vendor/product/firmware exposure as facts with criticality.
